newsitem.title: USA: Chase Corp, Stewart Group sell some assets.
newsitem.headline: Chase Corp, Stewart Group sell some assets.

text.p: Chase Corp said it and Stewart Group Ltd of Canada, joint venture partners in Stewart Group Inc, sold to Owens Corning some assets related to the manufacture of reinforcement products for the telecommunications industry, Chase Corp said.
In making the announcement, Chase Corp chief executive Peter Chase said Chase expects to realize a net financial gain in excess of $1.7 million from the sale.
Chase said its income from minority investments will vary according to the results of Stewart Group and other minority interests.
Chase said it expects to continue to maintain its equity position in the joint venture agreement with Stewart.
